# I6 · Follow-up Inbox

Group **I · Vận hành Clinic · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › followups · lọc Ảnh / Triệu chứng / Quá hạn, mỗi mục có người được giao

## Logic source
- Web: followups · lọc Ảnh / Triệu chứng / Quá hạn, mỗi mục có người được giao
- Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
- Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
- Web `clinic.js` › followups(): filters "Ảnh" / "Triệu chứng" / "Quá hạn"; doctors only see their own records (`owns`).

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.FollowUpInbox` ("follow-up-inbox") · app bar "Follow-up Inbox"
- Composable: `FollowUpInboxScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/aftercare/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/aftercare/FollowUpInbox.kt`
- Registered by graph: `followUpInboxGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `patient`, `staffContext`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/aftercare/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/aftercare/FollowUpInboxShotTest.kt:13` → `pema-kmp/feature/aftercare/build/shots/I6-vs.png`
- Canvas image: (run `gradlew canvasRefs`)

## Frame
- DetailScaffold(title = "Follow-up Inbox")  // back button, padding 20
